diagnostic_history: Computer Use exposed current values but reported a stale focused_element and a CacheRequest property error; those old outputs remain partial evidence, not passes or a claimed repaired tool.

The independent reader initially observed correct per-control states and IsReadOnly but global focus on another application. A separate foreground ownership check confirmed that the test window was not foreground; ordinary SetForegroundWindow returned false. These reports are retained as failed/incomplete validation attempts, not product failures reclassified without evidence.

Standard UIA SetFocus acquired the owned window and fixed the measured global-focus precondition. One driver run then stopped on a transient null Qt accessible interface while opening the popup. The scratch driver now waits 150ms and records nullable diagnostics; native assertions are independent and remain strict.

Both native-uia-independent-settled.json and the stronger final report passed all eight global focus phases and native read-only checks. The final report additionally asserts expected names/roles, disabled-to-enabled query state and exact known result values. No product modification was made during this observer diagnosis.

Standards review found that the observer must also reject a second sampled control retaining HasKeyboardFocus=true. The actual successful final report has exactly one focus target in all eight phases. After hardening the observer, a read-only revalidation of that report passed all eight uniqueness checks and rejected eight duplicate-focus mutants. This is revalidation of recorded native evidence, not a new desktop run.

The attempted post-hardening desktop repeat native-uia-independent-hardened.json failed its foreground precondition throughout and ended before result/returned phases with driver exit1. It remains a failed/incomplete attempt, not a replacement for the two successful native runs on unchanged product source.
